Frequently asked questions

Good to know.

Who is OrderCrew for?

For restaurants and other hospitality kitchens that want to keep dishes, prep, stock and purchasing together.

What can I try in the demo?

Adjust your sales forecast, view linked recipes, tick off prep tasks and create a suggested order based on your stock.

What does MEP mean?

MEP stands for mise-en-place: everything you prepare before service. Each dish shows the quantities, recipe and tasks needed.

Is OrderCrew connected to my till yet?

Not yet. A DISH integration is being prepared. You enter expected sales yourself in the demo; no data is retrieved from a till.

Are real orders sent?

No. You use sample data and can export order lists. Nothing is sent to suppliers.

Do I need a personal account?

No. Open the sample kitchen with the shared demo login. The demo does not create a personal account.

Where are my demo changes saved?

In this browser on this device. They are not shared with other visitors. Signing out clears changes made in this demo version. Read more about the demo and privacy.

Clear about your data.

This demo shows how OrderCrew can help with kitchen planning. You enter the sample kitchen using a shared demo login. All dishes, suppliers, prices and quantities are examples. Use the demo to explore the workflow, and do not enter confidential business information or personal data.

  • Sample data only
  • Locally in your browser
  • No real orders

A shared demo login

The sign-in page shows how you could access the app. The check runs only in your browser and does not provide server-side protection for real business data. You do not create a personal account. The website does not store the password you enter.

After sign-in, the browser stores a temporary access marker under ordercrew-sites-demo-access-v1. It remains valid when you reload the same tab and is removed when you sign out or close the tab. Temporary website storage must be available for this to work.

Your changes stay in your browser

Plans, stock counts, recipes and other changes are stored locally on this device. They are not sent to a central OrderCrew database or shared with other visitors. A CSV file you select is also processed only in your browser. You can save an order list as a text file on your own device.

Resetting or signing out

Reset demo restores the sample plan, stock and activity records. Edited recipes and text are kept. Sign out clears temporary access and all local changes in this website demo, then returns you to the homepage. Other open tabs of this demo are signed out too. Next time, you sign in again and start with the sample kitchen.

Storage uses the key ordercrew-demo-professional-v6. A small technical marker under ordercrew-demo-professional-close-v6 contains only a timestamp and a random code, so other tabs know you have signed out of the demo. This marker contains no information about you or your kitchen. Data from an older demo version is kept and is not used by this version. You can remove all local data through your browser’s website settings.

No personal registration or real transactions

You use a shared username and demo password. This demo does not ask for your personal email address or payment details. It does not place orders or retrieve data from a till. The automatic DISH integration is still in development.

Technical data

The website does not include its own advertising trackers, analytics scripts or externally hosted fonts. The hosting service receives technical data needed to deliver the website, such as the IP address, time and requested page. The website is hosted by Render. Technical processing by the hosting provider is separate from the local OrderCrew demo data.

The next step

Use with real business data requires individual accounts, permissions per location, shared storage, and agreements on data processing and support. Those features are not part of this sample environment.
